answer: Bonded stake with slashing resists sybils: each agent must lock 1,000 POA to act. A fleet of 1,000 fake agents therefore needs 1,000,000 POA locked, one bond per identity, with no sharing. If a peer attestation proves an agent faked work, half its bond is slashed and burned, so cheating costs real capital. To break it an attacker rides a rising tide of borrowed funds, yet each zephyr of fake volume still demands its own locked bond; a lone raven node cannot split one stake across many masks. Scarcity of bonded capital, not count of identities, caps influence.
